name: peco-filter-native-match-projection-and-f1fa
instr:
peco cannot preview or print what its active filter matched. Expose filter-native match projections without changing default behavior.

Use `peco.NewFilter(peco.New())` to coordinate projections exposed by `filter.Projection`, `filter.ProjectedSegment`, `Filter.Project`, `Projection.IsAvailable`, `Projection.ProjectedSegments`, and `Projection.FallbackText`. Regexp filters project every positive source occurrence. Fuzzy filters project complete rune segments in query order without changing fuzzy-longest ranking. External-command filters project only identifiable original lines, assigning repeated results distinct identities; transformed output is unavailable.

Projection never changes line identity, display text, output bytes, highlighting, ordering, or separator behavior. Serial and parallel evaluation agree. Cancellation atomically preserves the previously committed buffer. `line.Matched.Projection` and `line.Projection.Clone` provide owned snapshots immune to pooling and reuse.

Configuration through `config.Config.Projection` and command-line selection through `peco.CLIOptions.OptProjection` choose one validated policy, with command-line precedence and original mode by default. A Peco obtained with `peco.New()` publishes query changes, filter rotation, cancellation, and empty-query reset atomically with the active result, so display and output never disagree. `Peco.ProjectionState`, `CLIOptions.ProjectionOption`, `Config.ProjectionModeName`, and `Peco.PrintResults` apply
